# First native engineering client

`first-observations.json` retains five exact first records, including predictions
before each command. The initial CLI rejected the new command. After integration,
the same request rejected a mistaken prefix-array Basis spelling; a separate
translation changed only domain/codomain to full QIRF Basis objects. The one-qubit
T/identity comparison then met the phase-sensitive engineering bound 7/8.

The static reader in `scripts/test_engineering_pure_cli.py` checks all embedded
bytes and hashes without executing recorded argv or following their paths. Its
live checks use explicit current CLI/kernel arguments and separate temporary
files. The history is not an installation recipe, reusable acceptance receipt,
source/target preservation proof or completion of #31/#163.
